sources.title: CAWG Endorsement Assertion 1.0 Draft
overlap: signed approval for specific downstream actions
bounded permission relation distinct from basic content provenance
validity-bounded authorization-like evidence
non_overlap: content-workflow endorsement rather than a general AI-agent action gate
does not define PoAI availability or the UU-AAP seven-layer lifecycle
status_limitations: CAWG draft rather than final ratified specification
domain is C2PA asset workflow endorsement

sources.title: GAIDeT (Generative AI Delegation Taxonomy)
overlap: stage-specific documentation of generative-AI contribution
human oversight and accountability in AI-assisted research
structured human-AI delegation disclosure
non_overlap: reporting taxonomy rather than cryptographic or typed action-authority protocol
does not distinguish available intelligence from considered intelligence and decision authority
status_limitations: taxonomy does not claim execution-time enforcement

sources.title: CHEQ: A Protocol for Confirmation AI Agent Decisions with Human in the Loop (HITL)
overlap: human confirmation before AI-proposed actions are acted upon
signed confirmation object designed to compose with MCP and A2A
pre-effect human gate
non_overlap: confirmation protocol rather than full evidence-to-successor semantic stack
does not establish PoAI resource availability semantics
status_limitations: not IETF consensus or an RFC

sources.title: Blockchain-assisted explainable decision traces (BAXDT)
overlap: immutable per-decision structured trace
records what decision was made, why, based on what, and when
cryptographic integrity binding for decision evidence
non_overlap: SHAP/XAI-oriented trace rather than authority/action-permit semantics
records consumed decision context rather than a typed available-versus-considered intelligence set
status_limitations: blockchain integrity is not equivalent to authority or truth

sources.title: TAS-5: A Cross-Industry Framework for Transparent Disclosure of AI Involvement in Content Creation
overlap: media-agnostic AI-involvement disclosure
authorship transparency across text, media, code and professional work
non_overlap: disclosure-level framework rather than decision-authority provenance
does not define action permits, successor state or explicit non-effects
status_limitations: white-paper/framework publication rather than consensus standard
disclosure focus is narrower than full governance lifecycle

sources.title: Secure Intent Protocol: JWT Compatible Agentic Identity and Workflow Management
overlap: explicitly identifies drift between user intent and autonomous agent actions
extends OAuth-oriented authorization for agentic workflows
treats user intent as a security-relevant authorization boundary
non_overlap: JWT/OAuth extension rather than provider-neutral evidence semantics
does not define PoAI availability or a general outcome-successor protocol

sources.title: The Authorization Boundary: What MCP and AI Gateways Do Not Establish for Regulated Agentic AI
overlap: access authorization separated from action authorization
deterministic pre-execution authorization artifact
binding to policy/version state and replayable independent reconstruction
non_overlap: regulated action-authorization analysis rather than a human-AI authorship protocol
does not define PoAI compositional available-intelligence resources
status_limitations: SSRN/Zenodo conceptual work rather than standards consensus
author discloses commercial interest in deterministic authorization infrastructure

sources.title: Verifiable Intent
overlap: verifiable record of what a user authorized an AI agent to do
focus on proving user intent before consequential agentic commerce
non_overlap: commerce-specific industry mechanism
public announcement does not by itself provide a complete general protocol semantics comparable to UU-AAP
status_limitations: industry announcement rather than peer-reviewed paper or consensus standard

sources.title: Proposal for org.c2pa.digital-likeness — Consent and Permission-State Assertion
overlap: explicit statement that provenance is not permission
live permission-state treated separately from provenance, identity and rights metadata
tamper-evident pointer to external consent/permission evidence
non_overlap: digital-likeness consent use case
proposal does not define general agent execution authority or PoAI semantics
status_limitations: external proposal posted to C2PA repository
closed as completed does not mean normative C2PA adoption

sources.title: The Intent Token: A Cryptographic Authorization Primitive for Autonomous Agents
overlap: signed human-declared authorization envelope before action execution
explicit access-versus-action authorization gap
time-bounded action scope, delegation and anti-replay enforcement
append-only audit of enforcement decisions
non_overlap: intent-token authorization primitive rather than complete authorship/decision-evidence stack
does not model heterogeneous available intelligence separately from consideration

sources.title: Operating Model Protocol: A Deterministic Routing and Evidence Architecture for AI Decision Accountability
overlap: deterministic routing at decision time
tamper-evident trace emitted for individual decisions
accountability architecture rather than post-hoc dashboard only
non_overlap: confidence/routing architecture rather than UU-AAP semantic non-escalation stack
does not create the PoAI availability-versus-consideration distinction

sources.title: Agent Route Origin Authorization (AgentROA)
overlap: signed policy envelope for authorized agent action scope
monotonic scope narrowing through delegation
per-hop attestation and execution receipt at MCP tool-call boundary
non_overlap: agent authorization and delegation focus rather than human-AI authorship
no PoAI available-intelligence object model

sources.title: Decision Trace Schema for Governance Evidence in Real-Time Risk Systems
overlap: machine-readable per-decision governance evidence schema
combines inference, policy evaluation, cross-system coupling and governance metadata
degradation-aware evidence design
non_overlap: decision reconstruction schema rather than a typed authorization lifecycle
does not define explicit receipt non-effects across semantic layers

sources.title: Delegation Receipt Protocol for AI Agent Authorization
overlap: user-signed authorization object before agent runtime receives control
scope, boundaries, validity window and instruction-hash binding
append-only authorization record and explicit revocation
non_overlap: delegation-specific authorization primitive
does not define availability, consideration or successor-state semantics

sources.title: The Human Escalation Mechanism (HEM) for Agentic AI Systems
overlap: explicit machine state for human escalation
agent is prevented from proceeding while human decision is pending
human judgment is a separate governed transition rather than implicit runtime authority
non_overlap: kernel-specific SOOS governance architecture
does not address human-AI authorship provenance

sources.title: The Intent Declaration Primitive (IDP) for Agentic AI Systems
overlap: structured per-transition intent declaration
intent is distinct from access-token permission
intent is recorded at action-step granularity
non_overlap: agent-declared reasoning/intent primitive rather than user-intent evidence provenance
does not by itself define UU-AAP responsibility or PoAI availability

sources.title: The Governance Audit Record (GAR) for Agentic AI Systems
overlap: signed governance event stream for agent sessions
audit artifacts intended to survive adverse or inconvenient outcomes
explicit reconstruction of governed decisions
non_overlap: SOOS-specific audit architecture
does not make explicit non-effects a common semantic contract for all receipts

sources.title: The Agent Execution Protocol (AEP) for Agentic AI Systems
overlap: normative interface between agent reasoning loop and enforcement component
state and permission context delivered at each action step
policy enforcement plus tamper-evident transition recording
non_overlap: SOOS kernel/runtime contract rather than provider-neutral authorship-to-action semantics
does not directly model heterogeneous intelligence availability/consideration

sources.title: The Mandate JWT (MJWT) for Agentic AI Systems
overlap: authority bound to a specific resource instance, human principal, action scope and mission
delegation-chain traceability
governance binding beyond workload identity
non_overlap: JWT credential profile rather than a complete action/outcome semantic stack
does not model PoAI available intelligence

sources.title: Permit Receipts for Permit-Before-Commit Authorization of AI-Agent and Workload External Effects
overlap: effect-boundary interception before external commitment
canonical action digest and current-policy-state verification
fail-closed permit-before-commit decision
narrow claim that exact effect is not committed without machine-verifiable authorization evidence
non_overlap: permit/effect boundary rather than full decision provenance and authorship stack
does not define available intelligence or responsibility acceptance
status_limitations: IETF IPR disclosure exists for related patent US12640933B1

sources.title: Auditable LLM Autonomy for Operational Decision-Making: Big Data Evidence and Decision Traces
overlap: separate evidence, decision-trace and outcome planes
provenance and freshness constraints on decision evidence
action gating and post-decision outcome capture
explicit warning that recorded associations do not prove causality
non_overlap: review/assurance framework rather than typed authority and responsibility receipt protocol
evidence plane does not explicitly inventory unconsidered but available intelligence as a separate first-class set
status_limitations: review article rather than interoperability standard

sources.title: RFC 9943: An Architecture for Trustworthy and Transparent Digital Supply Chains
overlap: signed heterogeneous statements plus transparency-service receipts
auditable provenance and history
verifiable data structures for non-equivocation and statement registration
non_overlap: content-agnostic statement transparency rather than semantic action authorization
SCITT explicitly leaves many application meanings and trust decisions out of scope
status_limitations: scope is transparency of signed statements, not a complete agent governance lifecycle

sources.title: Provenance, Not Prohibition: A Framework for AI in Scholarly Publishing
overlap: provenance-centered governance of AI-assisted publishing
focus on tracing how claims, citations, analyses and interpretations were produced and verified
rejects simplistic permission/prohibition as the core transparency mechanism
non_overlap: publishing-policy framework rather than executable action-authority protocol
does not provide UU-AAP-style typed cross-layer receipt interfaces
status_limitations: does not claim general agent authorization

sources.title: Security Principal and Verifier Binding for Agent Communication Protocols
overlap: identity, user authority, delegation, session continuity and action evidence are explicitly separate claims
each claim has a distinct verifier, binding, freshness and failure behavior
warns that collapsing claims can imply more authority/accountability than can be verified
non_overlap: verifier-facing comparison discipline rather than full state-to-successor protocol
does not define PoAI availability or human-AI authorship

sources.title: Authorization Evidence Chains: Composing Heterogeneous Agent-Action Evidence (EP-AEC)
overlap: composes heterogeneous identity, delegation, policy, permit, approval, transparency, capability and execution evidence
native validity is insufficient without exact material-action binding
SATISFIED is explicitly not universal authorization and not proof of execution/outcome
executor makes a separate local authorization/effect decision
non_overlap: authorization-evidence composition around a consequential action rather than a human-AI authorship and available-intelligence stack
does not define a generic assertion plus non-effect contract across every semantic lifecycle primitive

sources.title: Mission-Bound Authorization for OAuth 2.0
overlap: durable human-approved mission artifact binds agent authority to user-approved task
explicitly separates mission issuance from per-action runtime enforcement
documents approval-to-execution gap and need for a separate runtime enforcement layer
non_overlap: OAuth authorization issuance profile rather than full action gate
does not model PoAI resource availability and consideration

sources.title: C2PA non-equivocation and optional append-only anchor proposal
overlap: signed C2PA manifest does not by itself prove it is the only manifest issued
append-only transparency and witnessed/anchored checkpoints discussed as separate evidence layers
signature/TSA evidence separated from non-equivocation and existence-time evidence
non_overlap: C2PA external proposal/discussion rather than adopted C2PA requirement
does not define general authority/responsibility semantics
status_limitations: open GitHub issue authored by an external participant
not C2PA specification adoption or maintainer endorsement

sources.title: CAWG Consent Assertion 1.0 Draft
overlap: signed machine-readable reference to authoritative consent/permission source
consent represented separately from basic artifact provenance
non_overlap: asset-consent assertion rather than generic agent authority
does not define availability, consideration, coordination or action outcome

sources.title: PETMALU-AI: A Reporting Checklist for Transparent and Accountable Generative AI-Assisted Research Writing
overlap: structured disclosure of AI-assisted research work
human accountability, AI contribution, prompting, provenance, validation, limitations and reproducibility
non_overlap: reporting checklist rather than machine-verifiable action authority
does not define a state-to-successor receipt protocol
status_limitations: reporting framework rather than runtime protocol

sources.title: From Neural Intent to Cryptographic Authorization: Governing Agentic Workflows
overlap: LLM/planner has no execution authority
deterministic controller releases exactly one authorized instruction at a time
tool parameters are strictly bound to signed instruction payload
mismatched or out-of-order calls fail closed
non_overlap: cryptographic workflow control rather than broad evidence/authority/responsibility semantics
does not model human-AI authorship or PoAI available intelligence

sources.title: Toward cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents
overlap: authorization evidence is distinct from identity, delegation, execution and audit evidence
binds principal, concrete request, execution context and policy satisfaction
formally identifies identity binding, authorization-request binding and runtime execution binding as separate properties
non_overlap: cryptographic authorization relation rather than end-to-end governance lifecycle
does not define PoAI availability/consideration semantics
status_limitations: preliminary model and proof of concept rather than mature standard

sources.title: Certified Amnesia: A Decision-Evidence Protocol for Provable Context Exclusion in AI Agents
overlap: decision-time context evidence bound to proposed action and current policy state
pre-action certificate plus separate gateway execution receipt
execution binding separated from exclusion assurance and explicit coverage boundary
non_overlap: context-exclusion assurance rather than comprehensive available-intelligence inventory
does not define human-AI authorship or full UU-AAP lifecycle
status_limitations: not peer reviewed or consensus standard

sources.title: Authorship After Generative AI: Distributed Creativity and Relational Responsibility
overlap: authorship treated as relational/distributed rather than simple human-purity test
human answerability and responsibility remain central despite machine contribution
non_overlap: philosophical authorship analysis rather than machine-readable provenance/action protocol
does not define exact authority or execution receipts

sources.title: CAWG Identity Assertion 1.3
overlap: credential holder proves control over a digital identity
actor role in asset lifecycle is represented as a distinct assertion surface
non_overlap: identity/role proof does not itself define decision authority or action permission
no PoAI available-intelligence model
status_limitations: asset identity scope rather than general agent governance

sources.title: Ethical LLM-Assisted Research: A Framework for Responsible Delegation, Verification, and Epistemic Value
overlap: separates contribution origin, verification, responsibility, human ownership and epistemic outcome
proposes structured epistemic audit for delegated LLM-assisted research
non_overlap: research-authorship framework rather than action-gate protocol
does not establish influence from or on UU-AAP because it appeared in the same narrow public window
status_limitations: same-day public window as UU-AAP stable-core/gateway issues prevents causal inference from chronology alone

sources.title: Broadcom AgentMinder
overlap: independently verifies agent identity and each action before enterprise resource access
checks declared mission, intent, context and current risk at runtime
non_overlap: commercial product announcement rather than public protocol semantics
postdates public UU-AAP/PoAI anchors and therefore is convergence evidence only in this audit
status_limitations: no inference of influence or derivation is made

sources.title: Stored Is Not Supported: Typed Provenance and Assertion Guardrails for Persistent AI Agents
overlap: persistence changes availability but not epistemic standing
typed provenance separates origin, dependency lineage, epistemic role, validity and disclosure scope
semantic assertions are mediated against evidence before release
non_overlap: persistent-memory assertion boundedness rather than general decision/action authority
postdates public Matawaka anchors
status_limitations: chronology supports only post-publication convergence, not influence
